Mod.Name: Mouse Keybinds / 鼠标键位支持
Mod.Author: YDXF
Mod.Description: 让游戏原生改键界面与储物协调器容器预设支持录入鼠标侧键（侧键 1~4），键名跟随游戏语言显示；录入已被其他功能使用的按键时弹窗确认（一键多功能，可关闭提示）；修复拖拽时滚轮偶尔无法旋转物品的问题。 Adds mouse side button capture (side buttons 1-4) to the vanilla key rebinding UI and the Storage Coordinator presets, with localized key names; shows a confirm dialog when a key is already in use (one key, multiple actions; prompt can be disabled); and fixes the intermittent scroll-to-rotate failure while dragging.
